title: Professional Opportunity in Forensic Science
prerequisites_raw: Completion of ( ANT407H5 or BIO259H5 or FSC341H5 or STA215H5 or STA220H5 or PSY201H5 ) Enrolment in a Forensic Science Specialist Program and Permission of Instructor. Students seeking 'crime scene' related experiences must have completed FSC302H5 or FSC303H5 . Course application is required. See the Forensic Science Program website for details.
